experimental.motion: Cropped bitmap segments in native RemoteViews ViewFlipper; sampled steps, not smooth continuous animation
experimental.timeline: All visible active effects must share durationMs; marquee and simulated equalizer use 12000ms
experimental.budget: At most 3 animated root segments, 2-12 frames, minimum 500ms frame interval, total 900000 bitmap pixels across responsive sizes
experimental.fallback: Static pose; marquee becomes ellipsis; equalizer holds fixed decorative bars
experimental.disabled: User motion switch, battery saver, system animation scale zero, mixed periods or bitmap budget overflow
experimental.compatibility: Requires launcher/device testing; API support alone does not certify a launcher

evidence: Android instrumentation Canvas and AppWidgetHostView capture
